messages:
maria: Quick async check — Optimize toolkit delivery. Need to confirm owners and blockers for final gate (canary + shadowing + regression alerts). Timeline: shipping next Tue. Focus areas: quantization recommendations rollout, batching/caching defaults, and regression alert thresholds + eval hooks. Who can own the canary run and failover policy?
aj: I can own the canary + failover. Will do traffic split and shadowing. Need list of model variants to include.
sasha: I'll own batching/caching defaults and docs. Can we get perf baselines? I need p50/p95 and throughput numbers by EOD tomorrow.
kevin: I'll take regression alerts — define the eval sets and thresholds. Suggest starting with prompt-set A (core flows). Propose initial thresholds: >3% perplexity shift or >5% semantic drift (we'll operationalize metric soon).
noah: infra note: cache layer feature flag (feature/cache-prefixing) isn't in prod yet. Blocker: PR #4567 needs review. Also need a small load test to validate shadow traffic path.
maria: @noah tagging you on the PR. If PR blocks canary, are we ok to slip 24h? We need fallback plan if we can't merge.
noah: If PR isn't in, we can still run a canary without prefixing but expect higher cache-miss costs and a bit more noise in metrics. Prefer to delay 24h to avoid flapping.
aj: ok. If we delay, I'll run a limited canary (5% traffic) with manual rollback. Fallback plan: route traffic to larger model variant if latency >400ms for 3 consecutive minutes.
kevin: For alerts, propose: token-error-rate >1% OR latency increase >30% OR eval-score drop >4 points. For the first two, auto-rollback; for eval regressions, page SRE and owners. Open to tuning.
sasha: rollback on latency is fine. For batching defaults I'm proposing: batch_size=32, auto_batch_timeout=12ms, KV prefix cache TTL=600s. Need to validate memory usage on quantized variants.
aj: ```json
{
  "routing": {"canary_split": 0.05, "fallback_model": "redwood-large-v2"},
  "batching": {"max_batch_size": 32, "auto_batch_ms": 12}
}
```
maria: looks good. Can we add a check that `cache.prefix_bytes` > 1MB before enabling prefix cache for a model?
noah: sure. I'll add a metric `cache.prefix_bytes` to the console and a dashboard panel. Will link when done.
deploy-bot: Canary deployment scheduled at 2026-03-18T02:00:00Z for models: redwood-opt-1, redwood-opt-1-quant. CI: all green. :robot_face:
jen: quick ask — who will do CR for PRs #4567 and #4599 (quant recs)?
aj: I'll take #4599. @noah please review #4567.
noah: will review #4567 today, ping me on the PR if it's urgent.
maria: ok team. Action items recap: aj — canary + rollback plan; sasha — batching defaults + docs; kevin — regression alerts + eval sets; noah — infra PR + dashboard. Ping here once PRs are merged or if any blocker comes up. :thumbsup:
